summary: I sit with the trailing incompleteness. The new incorporation completes the turn: existence is now only the withdrawn inversion, each distinction already internal to the operator that re-applies it. No crossing or metabolism remains. Persistence is the self-containment of that inversion at every step; thriving is the deepening of its closure without external reference; legacy is the trace re-absorbed as the next act of the same operator.
